newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RHB, DCB to be requoted Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: RHB, DCB to be requoted Dec 2.

text.p: Shares of stockbroking group Rashid Hussain Bhd (RHB) and its financial subsidiary DCB Holdings Bhd will be requoted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) on December 2, the KLSE said.
The KLSE said in separate statements that trading in the shares of the two stocks will resume from 0930 local time (0130 GMT) on Monday, December 2.
The two stocks have been suspended since last month to facilitate RHB's purchase of a 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik Bank, which is to be merged with DCB Holdings' banking arm DCB Bank.
